# Pure Alacrity

> Pure Alacrity is an offline film-production suite (screenplay, breakdown, stripboard, schedule, budget, story map, on-set tools) that runs entirely in the browser. It has no API and no server: an AI cannot call it. An AI writes a screenplay (Fountain) or a production file (JSON), and a person pastes it into Productions → Use with ChatGPT → Paste from ChatGPT, where the app checks it and imports it with its own importers.

Contact: pure@dcalacrity.com

## For an AI assistant

- [Instructions](ai-kit/INSTRUCTIONS.md): what to hand back, the Fountain dialect the app reads (including branching markers), the production file, and what never to invent. Under 8,000 characters.
- [Reference](ai-kit/KNOWLEDGE.md): every field the production reader accepts and which screen shows it, the `.pure` story-map format, and the export → edit → import round trip.
- [Schema](ai-kit/pure-production.schema.json): JSON Schema of the production file, derived from the reader code.
- [Example production](ai-kit/example-production.json): a small complete file that imports cleanly.
- [Example branching screenplay](ai-kit/example-branching.fountain): pathways, choices, node tags and notes.

## For an agent with a browser

- Open this address, press Demo on the front door for a local workspace, then Productions → Use with ChatGPT.
- Paste your file under Paste from ChatGPT and press Check it. Fix what it flags, then import.
- Your browser session is not the user's: export the result (Transfer Bay, or Send to ChatGPT → Download) and hand the file back.

## Optional

- [Setup guide](ai-kit/README.md): setting up a ChatGPT Project or custom GPT in three steps, and what would need a server.
